name: benchmark-hotpotqa
description: HotpotQA is a multi-hop question answering benchmark requiring models to combine information from multiple documents to answer open-ended questions and provide supporting facts. It measures a model's multi-step reasoning and evidence retrieval abilities across both distractor and full-wiki settings. Performance is typically evaluated on answer correctness and the quality of retrieved supporting facts.
reputation: A well-known and widely used benchmark for multi-hop QA and reasoning research.
